احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect 
 electric terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be 
 sure pump must be completely drained.

sections.text:
Pump out of
Operation
Check alignment and compare it with the setting value.
Check the bolts fixation, then retightens ( if it is needed ).
Check the validity of oil and purification by oil separator.
Check the glands (mechanical seal) for leaking and replace if it is needed).
Check flanges for leaking and retighten.
Check the pump casing against rust and re-paint (if it is needed).
Check the cooling water (Pressure-return water)
Check the thrust and radial bearing.
Check the pressure of balance disk 1.5MP
Check the instruments (vibration, pressure gauge, temperature, ...etc
